items.title: The class of the total space of a subbundle as the cap of a top Chern class
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the pushforward of a pulled back class from the total space of a subbundle into the total space of the ambient bundle as the cap of the top Chern class of the quotient with the class (statement lines 8838-8858, tag 0FAA). The proof reduces to modules of constant rank, constructs the canonical section of the pulled back quotient coming from the given surjection, and checks that its vanishing scheme is the subbundle and that on the preimage of an integral subscheme it is a regular immersion, so that the geometric case of the top Chern class yields the formula. The construction of the section and the regularity check are the substance, so the claim is H2.
